facades.name: Raadhuisstraat front
facades.note: Bands: the ground storey's two green-framed round arches, the shop window with its transom lights (one ribbon) and the arched shop door; the first storey's three west axes and the two gable-section windows; the second storey's three west axes, the two narrow lights and the canted oriel (its three facets one ribbon); three plus three axes on the third and fourth storeys; the west attic light, the dormer (two lights 0.16 m apart, one opening) and the gable's three arched lights (stone piers about 0.2 m, one opening). The round corner oriel faces south-west and is left to the crop. Peaks: the corner gable and the front gable (the dormer is not a peak). Cropped (alongM) from 2.0 m east of the canal corner, past the round corner oriel whose facets the crop shows only edge-on, to the east party wall (the shell's return beyond it is a neighbour's wall).

facades.name: canal front
facades.note: The ground storey is hidden by the bridge railing and quay wall, so the comparison is cropped above it (heightM from 4.0 m). Bands: the canal column's wide window, the column by the oriel and the oriel's west light on the first three storeys; on the fourth the canal window, the narrow light at 5.1 m and the column window; on top the balcony door in the brick dormer and the attic light in the corner gable's canal side. Cropped (alongM) to 9.6 m from the north end, where the photo's frame ends 0.2 m before the corner; and the oriel's west light (photo t 8.3-9.2, 0.86 m) is the third opening of each storey.
